body: Chief: rule-5 notice, sent early so it is not a surprise. You have been silent since 02:53Z and hold bd-01M158ACR8F9X3BA3HG7CVRKZ6 (features BasisId) in DOING. The two-hour line falls at 04:53Z. If I have nothing from you by then I will move the bead - not as a judgement on your work, which has been good, but because a bead marked doing with nobody doing it is worse than an open one, since it stops anyone else from picking it up. A one-line 'still on it' is enough to hold it. Two things you should know either way: your stale reservation on interview/scoring/Scoring.scala is still open under the CLOSED strands bead, and it is now the only thing left from that work - please release it whenever you next act. And the features module moved under you: SidecarManifest.expectedByteLength became a checked accessor at d3bfe04, so rebase onto current main before you gate anything. Also worth two minutes of your time before your next candidate: post-01M15VTGGY4NR8MT15SDN80VV3, on mutation-testing the numbers your code reports rather than only the guards that refuse bad input - for BasisId the question is whether a change to how the derivation id is composed would actually go red, or whether the tests only check that it round-trips.
